name: Nova Scotia

standard.note: Nova Scotia's everyday plate was recently redesigned for visibility: the painted border and left sticker well are gone and every plate type now uses a single font.

plates.title: Acadian Flag Plate
plates.fact: It shows the Acadian flag with 'Nova Scotia, Nouvelle-Écosse' across the top, and over 2,000 are on the road.

plates.title: Gaelic Plate
plates.supports: Gàidheil Air Adhart (Gaels Forward) Special Purpose Fund ($50 donation)
plates.fact: It carries the symbol of the Gaels in Nova Scotia and the words ALBA NUADH, Gaelic for Nova Scotia.

plates.title: Mi'kmaq Plate
plates.supports: Mi'kmaw Youth Special Purpose Fund ($24 donation)
plates.fact: It features a Mi'kmaw petroglyph and the words 'MI'KMA'KI Land of the Mi'kmaq'.

plates.title: Buy Local Plate
plates.supports: Community-based groups promoting Nova Scotia agriculture and seafood (Dept. of Agriculture partnership)
plates.fact: It cheers on Nova Scotia's own farm and seafood products.

plates.title: Conservation
plates.supports: Species at Risk Conservation Fund ($60.50 donation)
plates.fact: It's the province's most popular charity plate, with more than 6,000 on the road.

plates.title: Veteran
plates.fact: Nova Scotia was the first province to issue a government veterans' plate, in 2002.

plates.title: Retired Volunteer Firefighter
plates.fact: Retired volunteer firefighters get this plate with no renewal cost.

notes: Full list comes from Nova Scotia's open-data 'Specialty Plates' dataset (data.novascotia.ca 78vj-k5bf, latest snapshot 2026-07-14, counts of active plates per type), which is also the best robot_url: it is JSON and lists every type, but has no pictures. There is no single RMV page that lists all specialty plates with pictures; individual pages are under novascotia.ca/sns/access/drivers/ and /sns/rmv/registration/. 'Veterans Motorcycle Plate' omitted (motorcycle). No official pictures found for the active Volunteer FireFighter, FireFighter and Search and Rescue plates. Veteran/conservation GIFs are small (200 and 300px wide). Retired-volunteer plates' 2021 year is from a Feb 2021 news release title ('New licence plate honours retired volunteers'), not read in full.
